lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in roughly four to five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The highest-intensity maxima are clustered in the mid-lateral section, forming a semi-regular grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows, creating high-contrast anchor nodes, most prominently visible between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features extend horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (light upper edge, dark lower edge) consistent with structural dermal ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the posterior half of the fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated secondary silhouette (remora) is visible attached to the ventral region immediately posterior to the primary pectoral fin.
